Use case: stylized-concept. Production WHOLE-PERSON RUN cycle, continue the APPROVED running mechanics in reference 1. Reference 2 locks adult proportions, clothing and natural backwards trailing sword grip. Draw SIX COMPLETE CHARACTERS on a 3-column 2-row transparent sheet, requested native 2560x1440. Each figure anatomically SAME SCALE (neutral standing equivalent 610 pixels on requested canvas, compact head about93 pixels including hair). Full bodies, boots, hair and coat inside own cells with padding. Clean dark outlined cel shaded handpainted action sprite. No text, shadows, guides or effects.
Top-left: upright neutral three-quarter right-facing standing ruler. Top-middle: run phase0 NEAR RIGHT foot lands 50px in front of pelvis, far LEFT heel tucked behind. Top-right: phase1 near right support knee compresses, planted foot now30px in front of hip; far left heel lifts toward buttocks and bent knee begins forward swing. Bottom-left: phase2 NARROW PASSING, near right supports almost under hip, far LEFT bent thigh passes alongside support thigh, foot folded behind and close to pelvis. Bottom-middle: phase3 near right support leg trails behind hip pushing off toe; far left knee lifted forward at hip level, shin tightly folded backward, heel near buttock. Bottom-right: phase4 near right foot pushes behind, far left thigh forward, shin begins opening forward/down; body rises. Preserve distinct near and far legs, their occlusion must never swap identities. Right camera-near leg bears thigh buckle, left far leg dark and no thigh buckle. Pelvis/chest/head move together through weight acceptance and rise, no fixed torso/independent legs.
IMPORTANT WEAPON LAYERS: Every figure is a CLEAN BODY MASTER with NO WEAPON, NO HILT, NO SHEATH. Running right hand stays naturally behind hip in exactly the reference2 firm wrapped grip, curved thumb across curled fingers, leaving small EMPTY HANDLE CHANNEL between palm and fingers. The hand pose must be designed for the backward dragging sword shown in reference2, though NO weapon pixels may appear in this clean layer. Far free arm modest bent counter-swing. Backwards drag geometry is unchanged; do not change to forward carry. Whole character must be drawn together. Fingers are visible for later foreground masking, not separate hand insert. Silver white hair with red streak, black high collar coat red lining, BOTH forearms red wraps, black trousers silver armor. Adult slim long legs; compact head, no chibi. Neutral and runner heads same native size. Coat streamlines behind left but leave knees/ankles visible. One connected body in every pose.
